name: Jiangxi Qiyunshan Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Qiyunshan Food Co., Ltd. is a fruit snack company in China, founded in 1958 and based in Ganzhou, that mainly sells hog plum products. Its flagship hog plum paste comes in nine flavors and low-sugar, reduced-sugar and additive-free versions, and it also makes hog plum candy and gel and other fruit and vegetable pastes. It sells to offline distributors and through its own online stores, and is a subsidiary of Jiangxi Chongyi County Food Factory.
